fact.en: Mistaking the Shaka Era (78 CE) with the Vikram Samvat (57 BCE).
fact.hi: Mistaking the Shaka Era (78 CE) with the Vikram Samvat (57 BCE).

fact.en: Assuming Kanishka was the founder of the Kushan dynasty; he was the greatest ruler, not the founder (Kujula Kadphises was).
fact.hi: Assuming Kanishka was the founder of the Kushan dynasty; he was the greatest ruler, not the founder (Kujula Kadphises was).

fact.en: Confusing the Fourth Buddhist Council's location (Kashmir) with earlier councils (Rajagriha, Vaishali, Pataliputra).
fact.hi: Confusing the Fourth Buddhist Council's location (Kashmir) with earlier councils (Rajagriha, Vaishali, Pataliputra).
